facility.name: La Petite
facility.programs_provided: Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 5900 PAIGE RD, THE COLONY, TX, 75056

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: The caregiver in the naproom was observed using her personal device during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: One caregiver who has been employeed for over 90 days has not completed a first aid course.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The operations loose fill is compacted and measuring about 2.5 inches- 3.0 inches of loose fill.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing Before Eating: Children in the school age classrooms were observed being feed snack without washing hands. Based on information gathered food has been served at the operation without hand washing occurring.     CI: Children were taken to wash their hands by the caregivers, director, and assistant director.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing Before Eating (26 TAC §746.3417(1))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: Multiple classrooms at the operation have walls with chipped painted accessible to children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Medication Records: The medication log has not been updated for a child who has been given medication.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Medication Records (26 TAC §746.801(7))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Activity Plans for each group of children in the child care center: The acitivity plans were not posted in any of the classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Activity Plans for each group of children in the child care center (26 TAC §746.401(5))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Daily menu, including all snacks and meals served by the child care center: The menu was not posted and is not being followed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Daily menu, including all snacks and meals served by the child care center (26 TAC §746.401(6))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: One of the vehicle's seats is torn and has the cushion coming out.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room: The classrooms were missing emergency evacuation and relocation diagrams posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room (26 TAC §746.5207(b))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns: The operation is not following the USDA guidelines for when meals are being given. The children were not given a fruit component for lunch.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns (26 TAC §746.3301(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit: One vehicle's first aid kit was missing antiseptic solution.  This was corrected at inspection when the antiseptic solution was added.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on evidence of the investigation, a caregiver did not use good judgment when yelling and using profanity in the presence of children in care. In addition, a caregiver did not use good judgment when not intervening in a timely manner, while two children got into an altercation that resulted in injuries.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The wooden border on the playground has nails sticking out in multiple spots. A wire is accessible to children on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Five staff are missing the annual 24 hours of training from the last full year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Four children's files are missing a health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: One childs file does not have a health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Planned activities designed to meet special care needs-Integrated activities: For a duration of about 30 minutes, a child with special needs was observed sitting in the same spot, playing with the same toys.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Planned activities designed to meet special care needs-Integrated activities (26 TAC §746.2202(4))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: In the 2 year old classroom, children are not getting the same cots everyday. There is no system in place to ensure kids are getting the same cots.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink: During the inspection, it was determined that the food preparation sink in the infant classroom is being used to hand wash after diaper changes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.2419(8))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During inspection one child walked out of the After school classroom into the director's office without appropriate supervision. During the inspection the director was caring for two children in her office, while doing management duties. During the inspection the caregiver in the PreSchool/Pre-K classroom did not know how many children she had in care, even after using the tools provided by the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: The director is not ensuring that the operation is in compliance with the minimum standards due to the continued deficiencies being cited.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: The caregiver in the After school classroom was observed allowing a child to pull another child's arm and attempting to drag the child back into the classroom, without intervening.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Report Change in Controlling Person: The operation has not entered a person who should be on the controlling persons.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Change in Controlling Person (26 TAC §746.305(a)(7))

occurrences.finding: Report Change in Controlling Person: The operation has not entered a person who should be a designated controlling person.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Change in Controlling Person (26 TAC §746.305(a)(7))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe: On the younger childrens playground there where two animal broken bikes. On the older children's playground there was a bike with a broken seat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe (26 TAC §746.3701(5))

occurrences.finding: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Not Blocking Entrances or Exits: A child was observed sleeping infront of the emergency exit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Not Blocking Entrances or Exits (26 TAC §746.2909(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Three children's files were observed and did not have updated immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: Two staff files were observed and did not have first aid cards on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Product Certification: The children's product recall form was last signed on June 30, 2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Product Certification (26 TAC §746.801(18))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: The children's nap cots in the classrooms were labeled with numbers, but there is not a system in place where children will get the same cot everyday.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Daily menu, including all snacks and meals served by the child care center: The menu posted was from the week of February 27, 2023 and has not been updated for the current week of March.  This was corrected at inspection by, the current menu for the week of March 2023 being posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Daily menu, including all snacks and meals served by the child care center (26 TAC §746.401(6))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: Two staff files were observed and did not have CPR cards on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care: The center did not have the most recent fire inspection on file to be observed. The last inspection report on file is from August 11, 2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care (26 TAC §746.801(11))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Supplies Not Expired: The centers first aid kit and the bus first aid kit had expired medication, alchol pads, and first aid cream.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Supplies Not Expired (26 TAC §746.4003(b))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Based on information gathered from the investigation, the 21month to 3-year-old classroom was out of ratio with 1 caregiver and 13 children. The specified age group was 2 years old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: The director is not ensuring that the operation is in compliance with the minimum standards due to the total number of deficiencies in a two-year period, and repeated incidents where children are left unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A caregiver did not actively supervise children on the playground, resulting in a two-year-old child climbing the fence, and leaving the premises. The child was found by a bystander and returned to the operation by law enforcement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: Based on evidence obtained during a DFPS investigation, it was determined that a child was neglected as a result of inappropriate supervision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: The operation did not report to Child Care Regulations within the required 48 hour time frame. The incident occurred on 1/27/23 and the operation reported on 1/30/23.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: The operation did not share a copy of the incident report with the parent and did not get it signed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe: A tricycle was observed on the playground with a missing wheel. The wheel was found under the play stucture.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe (26 TAC §746.3701(5))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One child does not have updated immunizations in the file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening: Two children's files are missing hearing and vision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening (26 TAC §746.603(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: One child's file is missing a signed health statement from the physician.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: Four staff files do not have notarized affidavits.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Infant feeding schedules have not been completed for the infant classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One child is missing immunizations in the file. One child does not have updated immunizations in the file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening: Three children's files are missing hearing and vision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening (26 TAC §746.603(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report: The operations last health inspection was conducted on 3/31/2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report (26 TAC §746.801(12))

occurrences.finding: Caregivers Have Access to Tracking System: A child was transitioned into another classroom and was not signed in to the caregivers care. The caregiver did not have access to an iPad which is used to track sign in/out in the classroom
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caregivers Have Access to Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(b))

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk: A child was placed at risk when being able to get out from the Pre-K classroom, walk to the school age classroom and walk outside to the gated side of the building . The incident occurred on 5/19/2022 and the parent was notified on 5/20/2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: It was determined a child was able to get out from Pre-K classroom into the school age classroom and go outside to the gated side of the building and was left unsupervised. The child was found by a parent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: The operation did not provide an incident report to the parent within the 48 hours of the incident happening. The incident occurred on 5/19/2022 and the parent signed it on 6/1/2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)
